Description: Career Area: Technology, Digital and Data Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Description Provide support for Automation & Digitalization initiatives through the collection, integration, modeling, visualization, and analysis of data from manufacturing systems, ERP platforms, and other business applications, transforming it into actionable information to improve productivity, quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making. Responsibilities Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions. Analyze information from ERP systems, manufacturing systems, and other data sources. Education Bachelor’s Degree in: Systems Engineering, Information Technology, Mechatronics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field. English: Advanced level (B2-C1) required for global meetings, technical documentation, and presentations. Skills Data Analytics & Business Intelligence Proficiency in Power BI for dashboard and KPI development. Advanced Excel skills for data analysis. Knowledge of SQL for data extraction and querying. Understanding of data modeling and relational databases. Proficiency in Python for automation and data analysis. Knowledge of APIs and data source integration. Knowledge with ETL and data integration tools (preferred). Manufacturing Data & Operational Knowledge Knowledge in manufacturing environments. Knowledge of operational metrics such as OEE, Productivity, Quality, Traceability, and Downtime. Basic understanding of Lean Manufacturing principles. Knowledge handling data generated by manufacturing systems. Knowledge of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) (preferred). Enterprise Systems & Digitalization Knowledge working with data from enterprise ERP systems. Knowledge of SAP or other ERP platforms. Knowledge of Azure Data Services. Understanding of data architecture and integration. Knowledge with process automation and digitalization solutions. Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication Gather requirements from internal customers. Present analyses and recommendations. Facilitate data-driven decision-making. Collaborate in cross-functional projects. Preferred Candidate Profile Certifications such as: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer AZ-900 Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt Preferred tools: SAP, MES, Azure, ETL platforms. Differentiating knowledge: Industry 4.0 Data Architecture Automation Manufacturing Analytics Additional Information Administrative schedule: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Location: Santa Catarina, Nuevo León, Mexico. Travel requirement: Less than 10%. Occasional visits to manufacturing plants, training sessions, and digitalization projects. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. What you will do? Job Scope & Purpose Join us in the Procurement Execution Center as a BI Engineer II. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing best-in-class Business Intelligence by deploying business analytics, data visualization, data modeling, data mining and infrastructure to help the organization make more data-driven decisions. The BI Engineer is expected to scope, analyze, develop, automate, enhance, and validate BI reporting & analytics, and dashboard solutions in a timely manner. How you will do it? Produce and maintain scaled, automated, user-friendly reporting systems and dashboards. Support the data visualization process by monitoring and tuning queries and data loads, addressing user questions concerning data integrity, and troubleshooting functional and technical issues. Design and build of business-critical reports such as Scorecards and Compliance reports. Work with end users to understand their conceptual needs to production. Clearly understand and document conceptual requirements and build/request the data models needed to deliver the final report. Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, and analyses used to drive key business decisions per the Execution Center plan. Support annual activities and RFPs for Procurement Categories (i.e. Logistics, MRO, Professional Svcs, Fleet, etc.) by performing data extraction, data cleansing, and data prep for bidding purposes. Trains the Stakeholders from the corresponding business group by creating their dashboard together with them and by boosting our Dashboards usage. Other duties as assigned by your Manager. What we look for? Position Requirements Bachelor’s degree in related field (Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or similar) 4 + years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence, BI Data Engineering or other related fields Medium SQL skills for acquiring and transforming data Proficiency to draw insights from data and clearly communicate (verbal/written) information to stakeholders and senior management as required Experience configuring and using Power BI applications to effectively visualize and demonstrate proposed user interface dashboard and scorecard solutions. Experience in developing, maintaining and managing Power BI dashboards & analytics. Understanding of high-level programming languages. Python preferred. Ability to analyze and extract relevant information from large, complicated data sets of structured and unstructured data. Ability to adhere to plan developments, resolve roadblocks and adhere deadlines in a competing priorities environment. Demonstrate ability to story tell with data, as well as identify and root-cause both outliers and critical errors within the data. Demonstrate ability to identify and implement change, drive results, provide value-added analysis to assist Procurement leaders make informed decisions. Given the global nature of the role, advanced English is a must. Habilidad para construir indicadores desde datos crudos, identificar causas raíz y presentar conclusiones accionables. Experiencia levantando requerimientos técnicos hacia desarrollo, con seguimiento hasta implementación. Licenciatura concluida en Ingeniería, Sistemas, Administración, Actuaría o afín. Cómo trabajamos Cada análisis termina en algo implementado o en una decisión documentada — no se queda en el aire. Autonomía técnica sobre la configuración de la plataforma, dentro de política de accesos. Cuando otra área bloquea algo, escalas con propuesta y consigues el avance.
